mutations.name: a metrics row always draws a target cell
kills: a metrics panel drawn as a table draws no target cell for a row with no target

mutations.name: a scorecard row drops its reason
kills: a scorecard drawn as a table shows a row's reason beside its call

mutations.name: a row is shown before its reveal
mutations.find:
<TableRow key={row.id} id={row.id} atS={reveal(row.id) ?? i * ROW_EACH_S}>
            <th scope="row" className="beat-table-label">{row.measure}</th>
kills: a metrics panel drawn as a table hides a row just before its reveal and shows it after, under seekClock

mutations.name: a row loses its reveal id
kills: a metrics panel drawn as a table draws one row per slot row, each carrying its reveal id
